title: Reclusive girplan chain / Rolthee and Myrhee
summary: A chain of reclusive girplans leads to a quest-dependent named opponent.
overview: A chain of reclusive girplans leads to a quest-dependent named opponent.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Defeat each emerging girplan to bring out the next one.
Tanks should regain threat after the recurring knockback and hate wipe.
Each stage has a 930-second appearance timer; keep the chain moving.
The final branch produces Rolthee or Myrhee according to quest state.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
